configuration: 128 repetitions of a 1001-bin Gaussian-like distribution at fractions 0.5, 0.6827 and 0.9
observable: highest-density-region physical-bin membership masks, region counts and float32 threshold heights for three coverage fractions
default_vs_upstream: fixed deterministic instances replace Hypothesis sampling while preserving the upstream algorithm and assertions
variant: the complete probability distribution is scaled by two float32 ulps, preserving region topology while moving every threshold-height stream at its stored precision
altbuild: none: strax is a Python/Numba package and this check has no isolated alternative native build contract

evidence.floor_how: a read-only Linux probe found the first output movement at one float32 ULP and 8.940696716308594e-8 maximum spread at two float32 ULPs

warrant: The policy compares physical-bin membership masks, region counts and float32 density thresholds; interval-buffer slot order, padding and sentinels are intentionally discarded. strax/processing/statistics.py stores threshold heights in a float32 result buffer, and a Linux probe measured threshold spacings of 2.9802322387695312e-8, 1.4901161193847656e-8 and 3.725290298461914e-9. The finalized whole-distribution two-float32-ULP variant measured 8.940696716308594e-8 maximum spread, so atol 5e-7 gives about 5.59x headroom while masks and counts remain exact because the bound is below one; the human approved this policy, variant and tolerance at STOP 4.
